summary: FibroBiologics filed an 8-K disclosing an October 7, 2026 securities purchase agreement with Peak One Opportunity Fund for a $1,200,000 convertible debenture plus 125,000 restricted commitment shares. The debenture priced at $1,020,000, a 15% original issue discount, matures October 8, 2027, carries 0% interest, and converts only after an Event of Default at $0.78 per share. Interim payments of $1,080,000, $60,000 and $60,000 are due April, July and October 2027, with 50% of certain future cash proceeds above $1,500,000 applied to repayment. Watch dilution, default-driven conversion overhang, and liquidity.
